notes.phrase_cards: Each phrase is ONE FSRS item shown in three stages. Stage is chosen from the item's state: new -> meet (study only, no grade; FSRS starts after it); learning or fewer than 2 successful reviews on different days -> fill (type the gapped words; first-letter hints shown); 2+ successful reviews -> use (answer the message in your own words, graded with grade_with). A lapse moves the phrase back to fill. Fill is graded by exact gap words (case-insensitive, ' and ’ equal); use is graded by the phrase pattern.
notes.variation: To stop learners memorising answers, Fill and Use cards change on every review. (1) Each phrase has 4 fill_variants and 3 use_variants; pick a variant the learner has not seen in the last 2 reviews of that phrase, cycling through all before any repeats. (2) Fill the variables <DAY> <TIME> <NUM> <PERSON> at random from card_variables (keep the same value if a variable appears twice in one card). (3) Fade the hints: 1st Fill review shows first_letter_hints; 2nd shows only the number of words per gap; later Fill reviews show no hints. (4) Use cards are graded by the phrase pattern, so any correct reply passes; the model reply is generated, not stored, so there is nothing fixed to copy. (5) Meet examples are never reused as Fill sentences.
